text:
noah: Quick follow-up from today's infra segment  two asks from sales/customer success: exact phrasing for APAC pilot timing and a plain-language description of what customers see when a region runs low.

sophia: APAC pilot = invite-only late-Sept; GA depends on rack arrivals (conservative: early Q4). For customer-facing fallback: we try in-region first, then nearby region, then reduced-quality variant.

maria: Can we get that as a 1-paragraph blurb so CS can paste into emails?

sophia: Sure. Draft: "We're targeting an invite-only APAC pilot in late September, with broader availability expected in early Q4 pending hardware deliveries. If capacity in your nearest region is limited, requests will automatically be routed to the next best available region or a low-memory model variant; cross-region failover only happens for hosted plans unless you opt-in for Dedicated failover."

evelyn: Nice. For the GA timeline, legal asked whether we should avoid firm dates. Recommend: "target" and "expected" language.

sophia: Agreed. Use "target" and "subject to supply".

lisa: I'll publish a per-region headcount + procurement ETA table by Friday and start a weekly procurement digest. Owner: @lisa.

capacity-bot: snapshot 2142001200:
```
US-West: 94%
US-East: 89%
EMEA: 68%
APAC: 43%
```

noah: For the fallback UX, CS wants expected latency impact numbers to set expectations. Any roughs?

sophia: Rough numbers: in-region warm pool: +10-30ms p95; cross-region (same continent): +50-180ms p95; quantized variant: +120-400ms p95 and potential quality delta. We'll produce a small table with p50/p95 by Monday.

maria: Ops request: add a runbook snippet that says at what capacity thresholds we trigger each action (e.g., <50% warm pool -> warm cross-region).

sophia: Proposed thresholds: <60% -> throttling signals; <40% -> start cross-region warm pooling; <20% -> prefer quantized variants and conserve cache. I'll add to runbook PR.

lisa: Also raising vendor alert: vendor C delayed a batch, might push APAC buffer down ~8%. I'll post details in #procurement-watch.

noah: Great. Action items recap: sophia -> p50/p95 table + runbook PR by Mon; lisa -> procurement table + digest by Fri; maria -> coordinate CS blurb and legal-friendly wording. Ping when done. :thumbsup:

sophia: Ack.

maria: Thanks everyone. Small ask: exec-comm needs the final blurb before we send customer emails. Please loop them in.
